sentences.text:
The High Court has denied regular bail to the petitioner in 16:10:00 IST Reason:
connection with the First Information Report No.73/2024 registered with Special Police Station S.O.G. District - ATS & SOG, Jaipur, Rajasthan for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code respectively (for shot, IPC) and Sections 34 and 6 respectively of the Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1992 (for short,
1992 Act).

sentences.text: 3. We heard Mr. Shiven Gupta, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Ms. Shagufa Khan, the learned counsel appearing for the State.

4. Having regard to the fact that the investigation has been completed and charge-sheet has been filed and also considering the fact the petitioner is in judicial custody past 6 months, we are persuaded to exercise our discretion in favour of the petitioner insofar as his plea for bail is concerned.
We also take notice of the fact that the offences with which the petitioner has been charged with are Magistrate triable offences.
5. The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail, subject to such terms and conditions that the Trial Court may deem fit to impose.
6. With the aforesaid, this petition stands disposed of.
7. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(VISHAL ANAND) (POOJA SHARMA)
 DY. REGISTRAR COURT MASTER (NSH)
